race.comment: DON'T HOPE DO (3) finds a nice race. He's a genuine 1000m horse and his past two runs, both over this trip, have been good, second to Cavalry Girl in the G2 Caulfield Sprint then beaten half a length down the straight when bloused late. Back around a bend, he'll roll across and might just be too sharp. BRED 'EM ALL (8) is the one with upside. He won well enough in Adelaide fresh then measured up nicely behind the speedy Stokke at Flemington on Cox Plate day. OAK HILL (1) struggled in the Caulfield Sprint, never able to get warm. It was hard to make ground there, Sandown should suit him a bit better. PALLATON (2) is better suited back in trip. His sixth in the Caulfield Sprint was okay. TENNESSEE SPIRIT (10) is flying. She's very quick but this is a decent rise in grade.
